name: All Grass Farms, aka Barrington Natural Farms
description: All Grass Farms, aka Barrington Natural Farms is an agritourism farm in 681 IL Route 31, IL, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
